name: Absolute Coffee
why_included: Fast weekday wifi; three tables join into a communal work desk for a group.

name: Sweetleaf (Greenpoint)
why_included: Generous seating and reliable wifi; calm room suited to half-day sessions.

name: Birdee
why_included: Large, pleasant space listed for doing work; roomy enough for a group.

name: The Chipped Cup
why_included: Generally reliable WiFi, outlets, spacious back garden with plenty of seating.

name: Now or Never Coffee
why_included: Couches, natural light, reliable WiFi; space bookable for meetings; outlets limited.

name: Coppola Cafe
why_included: Free WiFi, bright natural light, round tables, restroom; better for a couple of hours than a full day.

name: Greenpoint Library and Environmental Education Center
why_included: LEED-Gold building; lounge seating, small meeting rooms, laptop loans; rooftop garden sometimes open for quiet study; open Sundays. Group.

name: 125th Street Library
why_included: Landmarked branch reopened Oct 2024 after $34M renovation; new teen center, elevator, upgraded heating and cooling.

name: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Library (SNFL)
why_included: Former Mid-Manhattan; ~44k sq ft public space with double the seats; free rooftop terrace (first-come); open to 8pm weekdays.

name: 11 Howard
why_included: Quiet second-floor Library open 7am-11pm serving coffee, tea and cocktails; strong Wi-Fi; good for writing and calls. Purchase likely expected.
